scope: Spline kinematic-sampling sub_pt_5, 3D BC_RC_Bayesian only, on a copy of alternatives/spline/sub_pt_5/histograms.root. Q2-y 1-17, 452 histograms. Bayesian, RC_Bayesian, Bin, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. The source ROOT file, budgets, sector exclusions, histogram weights, and the shared Phi_h guides were not edited. The destination did not already contain refinement_note.json and fit.json, so this is not a resume.
start_mode: spline. start=auto: the BC_RC keys these 452 histograms select have median B width 0.17 and only 5 are narrower than 0.05, and the C median width is 0.10 with 10 narrower than 0.05, so those windows are not tight. The run-local guide started as Prepare_Next_Iteration/Phi_h_Fit_Parameters_from_Spline.py. --use_spline_init was not passed.
changed: Pass 1 refit all 452 histograms with the run-local copy of the universal spline file and the corrected filled-window range. 450 selected spline keys match the manual keys that made the stored fit, so those histograms did not move. (Q2_y_Bin_15)-(z_pT_Bin_24) is the spline 3D-BC key rather than the tighter manual BC key, and that pass lowered its chi-squared. (Q2_y_Bin_9)-(z_pT_Bin_32) already sat inside the wider spline window and did not move. Pass 2 opened only the histograms whose own cosine was outside the guide or was stuck in the rough-start window. It did not copy nominal parameters. JSON still has 452 bins. 23 histograms have a lower chi-squared than the stored fit and none is higher by more than 0.05. Largest drops: (Q2_y_Bin_13)-(z_pT_Bin_4) 85.112 to 17.107; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_16) 42.244 to 17.297; (Q2_y_Bin_3)-(z_pT_Bin_29) 44.119 to 19.191; (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_33) 29.318 to 10.256; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_17) 36.366 to 24.880; (Q2_y_Bin_14)-(z_pT_Bin_5) 30.815 to 20.623; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_16) 35.013 to 28.314; (Q2_y_Bin_4)-(z_pT_Bin_34) 16.088 to 10.082. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) was stored at the second-pass edge B=-0.045 from the legacy BC limits [-0.03, 0.05] and C [0, 0.1]. It is kept at B=-0.130084, statistical error 0.083526, C=-0.065935, error 0.037410, chi-squared 1.732, NDF 13.0, phi 60-300, 16 histogram bins inside the TF1 range. That is this histogram's cosine, not the nominal BC B=-0.116016 and not the acceptance B=-0.125191.
left_bins: No 5D family is in this file, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Large nominal-minus-variation shifts that already match this histogram were not moved: (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_7) B=-0.014521 versus nominal -0.075000, shift +0.060479; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_15) B=-0.124898 versus nominal -0.068145, shift -0.056753; (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_3) B=-0.133493 versus nominal -0.183909, shift +0.050417. (Q2_y_Bin_5)-(z_pT_Bin_7) keeps a cos(2phi) value consistent with zero; opening it does not change the chi-squared. Collapsed parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and they are not added to the systematic budget. Excluded sector pairs were not put back. Missing comparisons were not filled with zero. The P_T subdivision source was not removed. Remaining collapsed or spike notes: (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_32) pull 6.47 at 352 deg, fraction 0.74.
unresolved: No retained bin is still more than 1 chi-squared above its own unconstrained cosine, so another guide change would not help. The remaining high chi-squared is the histogram shape. (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_4) 3.700 (chi2 59.192, NDF 16.0); (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_3) 3.555 (chi2 49.770, NDF 14.0); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_2) 3.202 (chi2 48.032, NDF 15.0); (Q2_y_Bin_2)-(z_pT_Bin_3) 3.157 (chi2 41.042, NDF 13.0). why_retained: Pass 2 is kept because every histogram chi-squared is at least as low as the stored fit, 23 are lower by more than 0.05, and the curves follow each sub_pt_5 histogram. (Q2_y_Bin_1)-(z_pT_Bin_8) is no longer pinned at B=-0.045. The nominal value was not imposed. Near-zero parameter errors that remain are a stability note, not a smaller systematic uncertainty, and fit-parameter errors were not added to the systematic.
